pages.text: The source never shrinks, yet the cauldron fills below the dripstone. The mimic remembers the drops, the wait and their chance to fall.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Lava Bucket$(br)Pointed Dripstone$(br)Cauldron$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Sequence and Delay$(br)Rune Plate: Numbers and Chance
